page.overview:
Who is Doseki Ganryū?

Like his classmates, he is quite curious and has watched princess Kae and Kawaki's behaviour with interest.

Doseki is a very large boy with plump cheeks and grey eyes. He has short, curly brown hair, and the most prominent part of his appearance is his bushy unibrow. Doseki wears a green T-shirt and brown pants tied with black cloth.

Doseki attended the Academy opening ceremony as part of a new class. His classroom was put under the care of new teacher Hana Kaka. His class included many children of famous people, including the daughter of an acting duo, the daughter of the Seventh Hokage, and Kae Yukiwari, the princess of the Land of Bamboo. The class also included Kawaki, a noticeably older student.

Later, a practice session was used for various competitions to teach the students how to work as teams of 3. Doseki was teamed up with Ran Sōgi and Yuina Itomaki.
